tool_args.rationale: The pilot horizons are at most 0.48, whereas the forecast horizon is 21.5. The specified slow-horizon probe directly tests and calibrates the guided adaptation mechanism at the relevant timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model using pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow adaptation timescale or its long-horizon contribution.
Additional short trajectories would be less informative about the long-horizon reversal than the selected probe.
It does not address the temporal identifiability ambiguity.
